topic: Analytics data migration and validation issues
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on migrating updated analytics data from a staging environment to production. Initial checks revealed discrepancies, specifically regarding the dwell time calculation for unique keys (ЮК). It was determined that the version deployed to production was outdated compared to the staging version (0.14.12). The deployment process required multiple attempts due to technical issues (VPN/Kubernetes). After a successful re-deployment and subsequent checks, the new dwell time data appeared in the analytics dashboard.
decisions: The updated analytics dataset was migrated from staging to production.
The dwelling time calculation needed correction on the production environment.
action_items: Monitor the stability of the deployed version in production.
